start.text: The new defenses are in place. This attacker does not break in. It offers you something.
start.name: Joshua

A.text: Joshua! It sends envelopes, a page that looks like ours, and a key that is not its own.
A.name: Carla

B.text: A lure, a fake login page and a stolen password. That is three tricks.
B.name: Joshua

C.text: Each one wants you to trust it. Look closely before you touch.
C.name: Carla

D1.text: [b][color=red]Lure[/color][/b]: envelopes with words on them. Fakes shout URGENT or PRIZE, and real ones heal you. [b][color=red]Fake login page[/color][/b]: it looks harmless, then turns. [b][color=red]Stolen password[/color][/b]: a key that is not its own.
D1.name: Carla

D2.text: That depends on the upgrades you equipped. Each trick has one defense that stops it. Without it, the trick comes back [b][color=red]harder[/color][/b].
D2.name: Carla

E.text: Use your cards to hit it, and [b][color=green]Reflect[/color][/b] what lands on you. When it attacks, you dodge, and you read the envelopes.
E.name: Carla

F.text: Understood. Let's look closer, and not trust the shine.
F.name: Joshua

G.text: Everything I set up in Hardening is about to be tested.
G.name: Joshua
